title: Review of c20's fuel-ring finding: replicates on fresh seed 31; a ring-free twin with uniform Df=0.3 divides at least as much as the ringed world and confines fuel to the rods just as sharply
summary: Re-ran c15's nematic-fuelcell world unchanged on fresh seed 31 (128^2, T=1000) plus three arms on the same seed: chi_s=0 (ring removed), chi_s=0 with Df 2.0 -> 0.3 everywhere (c20's twin), and chi_s=0 with Df=0.6 (an intermediate value c20 did not run). Persistent splits / max generation / final bodies: world 8/2/22, chi_s=0 4/2/13, slow-D 0.3 10/3/22, slow-D 0.6 6/1/21. Core fuel (c15's ringstat.py): 0.57, 0.35, 0.68, 0.50; the world's ring is closed on 66/66 bodies, the twins have none. compare_s31.png shows the ring-free Df=0.3 twin holds fuel inside its rods as sharply as the ring does, with the same rod shapes. So c20's reading holds on a new seed: the ring's effect on fuel and division is reproduced by uniformly slower fuel diffusion, with division rising monotonically as Df falls (0.6 -> 0.3).

observations.finding: ringstat.txt and FACTS.md: world 8 persistent splits/gen 2/22 bodies, core fuel 0.57; chi_s=0 4/2/13, 0.35; chi_s=0+Df=0.3 10/3/22, 0.68; chi_s=0+Df=0.6 6/1/21, 0.50. compare_s31.png row 3: fuel confined to rods in world and Df=0.3 twin, smeared in chi_s=0

seeds_run.result: pass: twin (Df=0.3) >= world in splits and generation; ring ablation halves splits

controls_run.finding: controls/chis0_s31, controls/slowD03_s31, controls/slowD06_s31 (same seed, grid, duration as rerun/seed31)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; splits counts at this population size (4-10) are noisy, so 'split for split' is only roughly matched (the twin slightly exceeds the world here, 10 vs 8). Fuel is made inside the droplets (kf * inside^4), so both the ring and slow D act by retaining self-made fuel; the finding says nothing about a ring gating an external food. The twin's ringstat body count is lower (30 vs 66) because crowded twin rods often fail the outside-band filter, not because fewer bodies exist (labkit final 22 vs 22). No dt or grid variant run.
